After reload, refreshed proxy bearer values can replace the initial token used for fixture progress reads. Prefix includes trailing slash and current web origin, so unrelated URLs do not match. Full4-hunk diff contains no assertion, scenario, timeout or runtime changes. Existing notice priority requiresNewBudget before pauseReason is unchanged from252de64; carrying true would test budget notice instead of the requested credits/capacity/model/provider state. Contract accepts the boolean without a cross-field budget constraint. All rare-state title assertions and real preparation/reconnect/practice before injection remain unchanged; dedicated requiresNewBudget:true coverage remains in sentence-preparation-notice.test.tsx. This proves fixture isolation only, not real backend pause transitions.
